# Foundation Quality Checklist: Initial Application Foundation

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality checklist covering accessibility, responsive UX, quality gates, architecture, environment config, and testing for the initial foundation.
**Created**: 2026-10-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the required UI primitives for the shell explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Are loading-state conventions defined for all async operations that may exist in the foundation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Are error-boundary fallback behavior requirements (message + recovery) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Is the not-found route behavior specified with acceptance criteria? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Are environment variable conventions documented including required vs optional? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK006 Are accessibility requirements specified for all interactive shell elements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Are FSD layer responsibilities defined sufficiently for planning? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK008 Are backend integration boundary requirements documented without over-specifying? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "responsive" quantified or tied to observable behavior rather than arbitrary pixels? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK010 Is "calm, friendly, minimalist" translated into measurable visual criteria or referenced tokens? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK011 Are design token categories (color, typography, spacing) explicitly listed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK012 Is the fail-fast condition for environment config unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do pre-commit/pre-push/CI responsibilities align with Constitution §16? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK014 Are accessibility claims consistent with the "automated alone insufficient" note? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK015 Are responsive criteria consistent between user stories and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Is "shell renders" verifiable without implementation details? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK017 Is developer setup time threshold measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK018 Are accessibility success criteria objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are zero-JS / disabled-JS fallback requirements specified? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are very small/large viewport behaviors addressed? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are unhandled error scenarios addressed? [Coverage, Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK022 Are performance expectations for initial load stated? [NFR, Spec §VIII]
- [x] CHK023 Are i18n requirements (en/es, fallback, lazy loading) specified? [NFR, Spec §XIV]
- [x] CHK024 Is the light default theme requirement unambiguous? [NFR, Spec §FR-014]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK025 Are assumptions about frontend stack documented and consistent with Constitution? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 Are out-of-scope items explicitly listed? [Scope, Spec Out of scope]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK027 Are "supported viewport sizes" defined or explicitly deferred? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK028 Are mandatory environment variables identified or confirmed none? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
